dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: We're still in the design phase, of course. I shall have to undertake some discussions to perfect the plans before construction begins.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Ah... What an investment of resources and manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Such wonders are only possible thanks to our God King's grace. I am truly blessed to have been granted the opportunity to dedicate my life to this work...
